title: Police Simulator X Kill All
features:
You need a gun for it to work (AFK for like 10 minutes to get money then just get a glock), all the admins get triggered lol

This script also works on any game that uses carbon engine

Enjoy!
script:
for _,v in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if v ~= game.Players.LocalPlayer and v.Character  then
        if v.Character.PrimaryPart then
            game.ReplicatedStorage.CarbonResource.Events:GetChildren()[4]:FireServer(v.Character.Humanoid, 100, "Head", {'nil', 'Auth', 'nil', 'nil'})
        end
    end
end
